class.name: YAML
class.brief_description: Converts between YAML text and Godot data structures.
class.description: Main interface for working with YAML in Godot, providing methods to parse, validate, and serialize YAML data. YAML (YAML Ain't Markup Language) is a human-friendly data serialization standard commonly used for configuration files, data exchange, and storing structured information in a readable format. This class automatically handles conversion between YAML and standard Godot variant types, except for [Callable] and [RID].

method.name: allow_resource_path
method.description: Allows resource loading from a specific path prefix for the default security instance. If [param type_names] is empty, allows all non-blocked resource types from this path. This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance. For more control, create a custom [YAMLSecurity] instance using [method create_security]. By default there are no path restrictions, but Script and GDExtension resource types are blocked for security reasons.

method.name: block_resource_type
method.description: Blocks a specific resource type globally for the default security instance. Any resource of this type will be rejected during parsing. This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance. For more control, create a custom [YAMLSecurity] instance using [method create_security].

method.name: create_security
method.description: Creates a new security configuration object for controlling resource loading during YAML parsing.

method.name: create_style
method.description:
Creates a new style configuration object for customizing YAML serialization. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Create a custom style for YAML output var style = YAML.create_style() style.set_scalar_style(YAMLStyle.SCALAR_LITERAL) style.set_quote_style(YAMLStyle.QUOTE_DOUBLE)
# Convert data to YAML with custom style var data = { "name": "Player", "description": "A player character", "inventory": ["Sword", "Shield", "Potion"] } var result = YAML.stringify(data, style) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: has_registered_class
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a class is registered for YAML serialization with the given tag name.

method.name: load_file
method.description: Loads and parses a YAML file from the given path. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data or error information. If [param detect_style] is [code]true[/code], the method also detects and returns style information that can be used to preserve formatting when modifying and re-serializing the YAML. If [param security] is provided, it will be used to validate resource loading. Otherwise, the default security settings will be used. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Load and parse a YAML file var result = YAML.load_file("res://data/config.yaml") if result.has_error(): print("Error: ", result.get_error_message()) print("At line: ", result.get_error_line()) else: var data = result.get_data() print("Loaded configuration: ", data) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: parse
method.description:
Parses a YAML string into Godot data structures. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the parsed data or error information. If [param detect_style] is [code]true[/code], the method also detects and returns style information that can be used to preserve formatting when modifying and re-serializing the YAML. If [param security] is provided, it will be used to validate resource loading. Otherwise, the default security settings will be used. Multi-document YAML (separated by [code]---[/code]) is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method YAMLResult.get_document] or [method YAMLResult.get_data] with an index parameter. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Basic YAML parsing var yaml_string = """ player: name: Hero level: 10 inventory: - Sword - Shield """
var result = YAML.parse(yaml_string) if result.has_error(): print("Error: ", result.get_error_message()) else: var data = result.get_data() print("Player name: ", data.player.name) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: register_class
method.description:
Registers a custom script class for YAML serialization and deserialization. The [param script_class] must be a Script resource. The class should implement two methods: 1. A serialization method (default name: [code]serialize[/code]) that returns a serializable representation of the object 2. A static deserialization method (default name: [code]deserialize[/code]) that takes a value and returns a new instance of the class The [param serialize] and [param deserialize] parameters can be used to specify custom method names if the class uses different names. Once registered, the class can be automatically serialized to and from YAML with proper type information preserved using YAML tags. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Define a custom class class_name Player extends Node
var name: String var level: int
static func deserialize(data): if typeof(data) == TYPE_DICTIONARY: var player = Player.new() player.name = data.get("name", "") player.level = data.get("level", 1) return player return Player.new()
func serialize(): return { "name": name, "level": level }
# Register the class with YAML YAML.register_class(Player) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: reset_security
method.description: Resets the default security settings to defaults. Clears all custom settings and re-adds the default blocked types (Script and GDExtension). This method delegates to the default [YAMLSecurity] instance.

method.name: save_file
stringify
method.description:
Converts Godot data to YAML text. Returns a [YAMLResult] containing either the generated YAML string or error information. If [param style] is provided, it will be used to customize the formatting of the YAML output. Otherwise, default formatting will be used. [codeblocks] [gdscript] # Convert dictionary to YAML var data = { "name": "Stranger", "dialogue": ["Hello, traveler.", "What brings you here?"] }
var result = YAML.stringify(data) if !result.has_error(): var yaml = result.get_data() print(yaml) # Output: # name: Stranger # dialogue: # - "Hello, traveler." # - "What brings you here?" [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: validate
method.description: Validates YAML syntax without full parsing. Returns a [YAMLResult] indicating success or containing error information. This method quickly checks if YAML is syntactically valid without creating full Godot data structures. It's faster than [method parse] but doesn't provide the parsed data.

method.name: version
method.description: Returns the version of the YAML extension as a string with version and build information.
